picks.headline: Alibaba Releases Open-Source Qwen 3.8 27B Vision Model
picks.why: It delivers an Apache 2.0 open-weights 27B vision model with a 262k context window, though its default reasoning setting can cause unnecessary latency.
picks.title: Qwen 3.8 27B is excellent, but it defaults to wildly overthinking things

picks.headline: Side-Channel Attack Recovers Encrypted LLM Reasoning Traces from Network Traffic
picks.why: Demonstrates that encrypted base64-encoded reasoning tokens transmitted over messaging protocols can be reconstructed by unauthorized eavesdroppers.
picks.title: Recovering Encrypted LLM Reasoning Traces

picks.headline: Enterprise Reference Deployment for Sovereign AI Agents on AWS SageMaker
picks.why: Provides a practical architectural pattern for hosting 50+ local Llama 4 Maverick agents while strictly adhering to regional data residency laws.
picks.title: How OneAdvanced deployed over 50 AI agents on UK-sovereign AWS

picks.headline: Iterative LLM Infrastructure Repairs Cause Security Regressions in 3.3% of Scenarios
picks.why: Automated Infrastructure-as-Code patch loops frequently introduce new security vulnerabilities through resource restructuring and high code churn.
picks.title: Does Fixing Break Security? An Empirical Study of Security Degradation in Iterative LLM-Driven Infrastructure-as-Code Repair

papers.headline: Parallel Auxiliary Reasoning Cuts Agent Idle Time During Tool Execution
papers.why: Utilizes the idle window while agents await environment observations to run auxiliary reasoning branches, significantly reducing overall latency.
papers.title: Second Thought: Reasoning in Parallel as LLM Agents Act and Observe

papers.headline: Study Reveals Reasoning Training Amplifies Thinking Behaviors Without Guaranteeing Correctness
papers.why: Exposes an Amplification-Lift Gap where reasoning models display more uncertainty acknowledgment without achieving higher task accuracy.
papers.title: Amplified Does Not Mean Predictive: Reasoning Behaviors in Thinking Models

papers.headline: sMuon Adapts the Muon Optimizer to Low-Rank Fine-Tuning
papers.why: Enables matrix-momentum updates for low-rank fine-tuning using only matrix multiplication operations instead of full-matrix operations.
papers.title: Approximate Muon with low-rank adapters
